title: Balance Update Query
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N,Q \leq 2 \times 10^5; 0 \leq a_i \leq 10^9; 0 \leq b_i \leq 10^4; For each query of the 1-st kind, 1 \leq x \leq N and 0 \leq y \leq 10^9.; For each query of the 2-nd kind, 1 \leq x \leq N and 0 \leq y \leq 10^4.; For each query of the 3-rd kind, 1 \leq x \leq 10^9.; There is at least one query of the 3-rd kind.; All values in the input are integers.
